nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Banana Bright 15% Vitamin C Serum for Dark Spots and Firming

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are mostly positive, reporting no irritation, stinging or breakouts even with the citrus fragrance, though a minority experience noticeable redness or slight stinging during the first week that fades as their skin adjusts to the vitamin C strength.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some who are acne-prone, consistently report no issues, breakouts or excess oil, alongside brighter, more even-looking skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s report brighter, more even skin and fewer fine lines or dark circles, though one is not sure about visible firming so early on and another found the strength enough to cut back to every other day.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers who target dark spots, melasma, hyperpigmentation or dark circles report visible fading with consistent use over two weeks to a few months, including one whose 15-year melasma patch lightened and another whose dark circles nearly matched the rest of her skin; a few disagree, saying they saw no real difference or that their pigmentation did not improve drastically.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts and some describe fading post-acne marks or scars with continued use; one reviewer notes that small breakouts or dry patches are possible during the skin's initial adjustment period.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers say the serum helps keep redness away or reduces it over time, but others report the opposite when they first start using it, describing noticeable redness or a flushed look during the first week that fades as their skin adjusts to the vitamin C strength.
concerns.aging: Several reviewers report a reduction in the look of fine lines within two to three weeks, including one who says her laugh lines had smoothed out; one reviewer using it specifically for firming says it is too early to judge that particular claim.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating despite its exfoliating acids, with several surprised it did not dry out their skin; a few note they still need to layer a moisturizer afterward or their face feels dry if they skip that step.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the finish as non-oily and non-greasy, including some who specifically expected a heavy or shiny residue and did not get one.

aspects.libelle: Distinctive citrus scent most reviewers love
Fragrance too strong for a few users

extraits.titre: Not the vitamin C serum I would reach for.
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Ole Henriksen Banana Bright Vitamin C Serum really did not impress me as much as I would've wanted it to. The serum is an off-putting yellow color and has a very heavy artificial citrus scent. Now, color and fragrance are typically things I can look past if the product is good. Unfortunately, I found the consistency to be too tacky for my liking and it took a lot longer to absorb into my skin despite the serum's claims. After multiple weeks of exclusive and consistent use, I still have not seen much of a difference in my skin. It is hydrating though.

extraits.titre: Brightening Results With a Potent Formula — But Sensitive Sk
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is definitely on the stronger side of vitamin C products, and you can feel that in both the results and the first‑week adjustment period. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and has that signature citrus‑leaning scent that fades fast. Once it settles, it layers cleanly under moisturizer without pilling or feeling sticky. In terms of performance, it delivers what it promises: brighter skin, smoother texture, and a more even look overall. After a couple of weeks, I noticed a clearer tone and a bit more firmness, especially in the areas where I tend to look dull. It hydrates well for a vitamin C serum and doesn't leave any greasy residue. That said, the formula is strong. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and during the first week I experienced some noticeable redness — no burning, itching, or dryness, just a flushed look that faded as my skin adjusted. Once that initial period passed, it stopped happening, but it's worth noting for anyone who reacts easily to potent actives. Starting every other day might be the safer route. The only real downside is that this serum can be a bit much for skin that isn't used to higher‑strength vitamin C or PHAs. It's effective, but it's not the gentlest option out there. If your skin barrier is already compromised or you're prone to irritation, patch‑testing is a must.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This banana bright vitamin C serum from Ole Henriksen is legit. From the absolutely delightful smell of oranges to the fresh moisturizing feeling it leaves my skin feeling it hits all the right marks. I have been using this as my first step in my skin care since it's got the vitamin C and it's also hyaluronic acid that plums up my skin. My skin looks and also feels amazing after using the serum. I have a melasma patch right on the skin to the left of my left eye. It appeared during my first pregnancy 15 years ago and got a shade darker with every baby I had after that. I absolutely hate that dark spot and try to keep it covered and taken care of so it doesn't get darker. With about 2 weeks of daily use I am already noticing that my melasma has lightened up quite a bit which is very welcomed. The serum goes on super well and is fast absorbed. It does not leave any gross or sticky finish and leaves my skin looking and feeling fresh and healthy. I will definitely buy this product going forward.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Ole Henriksen Banana Bright Vitamin C Serum for a few weeks, and I ended up enjoying it more than I expected. The texture is lightweight, sinks into the skin quickly, and layers well under makeup without any sticky residue. Over this period, my skin has started to look a bit brighter and fresher overall. One of my favorite aspects of this serum is the scent. It has a gentle citrus fragrance that feels calming and elevates my daily skincare routine. The packaging is also thoughtfully designed — clean, simple, and functional. The pump dispenser makes it easy to get the right amount of product without any mess. A few notes of caution: those with sensitive skin might experience slight stinging or redness initially due to the vitamin C. It's also possible to see small breakouts or dry patches while your skin adjusts. This isn't a miracle product that delivers results overnight, but as an everyday brightening serum, I find it to be a lovely addition to a routine. Pros: Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula Pleasant citrus scent Easy-to-use pump packaging Gradual brightening Cons: Possible initial stinging or redness for sensitive skin Adjusting period may cause minor breakouts or dryness Results are subtle and require consistent use ￼

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have combination skin, which can be sensitive to some ingredients, and I do struggle with breakouts. I have been using this serum for a few days without any issues. This is lightweight while still being hydrating! I notice an overall improvement that it has both brightened and evened out my skin tone. I love the citrus scent. I have used the Drunk Elephant C-Luna Serum for a long time. I feel that this is comparable to that product if it were also combined with Drunk Elephant's C Firma Fresh. So, I feel with this I am getting both products in one!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've loved Ole Henriksen products in the past and was excited to try this. I've been using it for over a week and feel like I notice a difference in the brightness of my skin. It's very light and a little bit goes a long way. I originally used it every day, but did switch to every other day because it felt like it was just a little much for my skin. I'm in my late-30s and am so glad to be adding this into my morning routine.

This brand consistently impresses me. I had dark spots around my eyes that really bothered me, I used this serum over months and they have faded to almost gone! The smell is fresh and very nice but not overpowering. I will say I have gotten a little in my hairline and it does leave a sticky residue there but not on the skin. I will continue to use this brand for my skincare! I received this product for free to review
